```{r}
mpg01<-rep(0,nrow(Auto))
mpg01[Auto[,'mpg']>median(Auto[,'mpg'])]<-1
mpg01=as.factor(mpg01)
auto01=data.frame(Auto,mpg01)
table(mpg01)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
boxplot(acceleration~mpg01,auto01,main="accel~mpg01")
boxplot(weight~mpg01,auto01,main="weight~mpg01")
boxplot(horsepower~mpg01,auto01,main="horse~mpg01")
boxplot(displacement~mpg01,auto01,main="disp-mpg01")
```
```{r}
training_data=auto01[1:196,]
testing_data=auto01[196:392,]
```
```{r}
model=glm(mpg01~horsepower+displacement,family=binomial,training_data)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
model_pred=predict(model,testing_data[,c('horsepower','weight','displacement')])
model_class=ifelse(model_pred>0.5,1,0)
table(model_class,testing_data[,'mpg01'])
```
